determination: A real staging conflict with another live session was observed twice while attempting a normal git commit for this pass own new work (first: 589KB of unrelated files staged in the shared index; second: backlog/BACKLOG.md itself had substantial unrelated in-progress reorganization from another session in the live working tree). Both times, per this taskcard own stop_conditions, fell back to isolated git-plumbing rather than forcing a normal commit. Pre-commit Step 30 therefore remains unproven on a real, hook-driven git commit as of this mission closure -- proven correct via 22 tests + a manual scratch-repo dry run + the manually-invoked check itself passing clean twice on real proposed content (CLAUDE.md, backlog/BACKLOG.md), but the LIVE HOOK PATH specifically has not fired. Recorded as a genuine, non-blocking, honestly-tracked limitation -- same shape as MT016 own L2-MT016-02 precedent for a comparable not-yet-proven-on-the-real-path gap.
